title: Reason X by DeepSeek: 3 Features Built Without Touching the Code
description:
Forget Cursor. Reason X just launched and I built three features back to back without writing a single line of code. 

Three step setup: install from the DeepSeek site, connect your repo with 12 million token full context working memory, then just tell it what to build. No chunking, no retrieval, no interruptions. And it's 75% cheaper than the alternatives. Benchmarking it against Claude Code soon. 

Get the ReasonX guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zGuDdGv_xPcn_IckxGdjm0R_zyCKmdPP/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
